9to5Mac Daily records a new episode every weekday. Subscribe on Apple Podcasts or through your favourite podcast player so a new episode lands in your ears the moment it’s released.

Stories discussed in this episode:

  • AT&T appears to have no plans to support Apple's new iPhone Handoff feature
  • Disney+ and Hulu have hiked their prices — here's what they now cost
  • Apple says a software update to fix the iPhone 18 Pro reboot bug is coming next week
  • Some iPhone 18 Pro users hit a Face ID bug causing the system to crash and reboot
  • The iOS 27.0.1 update is coming soon for iPhone
